sample / RTSP response.rule: §5.2 Status line: exactly HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1

sample / ICE response.rule: §5.2 Status line: exactly HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1

sample / HTTP version 0.9.rule: §5.2 Status line: exactly HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1; HTTP/0.9 rejected

sample / No reason phrase.rule: §5.2 Status line: one SP, 3 digits, SP, reason phrase (the SP after the status code is required)

sample / Response starting with CRLF.rule: §5.2 Status line: the head starts with HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 (no empty lines are skipped before it)

connection / HTTP 100 first, then 400.rule: §5.2 Status line: the head after an interim response starts with HTTP/1.0 or HTTP/1.1 (no empty lines are skipped before it)

invalid / CR before response and tab aft.rule: §5.2 Line endings: a bare CR anywhere in the head is rejected
